Name: Egghead Farmer (No More Nose)
Description:
This mod makes very small changes to the farmer sprites that you can turn off by editing config.json.

NoNose(Guy/Girl): true, false - [b]Removes the nose from either farmer sprite
[/b]CuteEyesGuy: true, false - [b]Gives the male farmer eyes a rounder and softer look, similar to the female farmer
[/b]ChinGuy: true, false - [b]Gives the male farmer a slightly taller face, more like an oval[/b]

The nose edits aren't compatible with other body modification mods, but the eyes and chin options can be combined with other mods.

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/88]RPG style main character sprite[/url], but the assets were remade by me.
Recolor mod in banner: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18223]Yri's Retro Recolor[/url]
